app.name: Dietitian Clinic Management
app.tagline: One platform for clients, nutrition plans and appointments.

landing.title: Run your dietitian practice in one place
landing.description: Follow up on clients, build nutrition plans, schedule appointments and record payments — in Arabic and English.
landing.foundationNotice: This is a foundation build: structure, auth and i18n are in place, no feature modules have been built yet.

login.title: Sign in
login.staffDescription: Sign in with your email and password.
login.areYouStaff: Are you on the clinic team?
login.signUpSubtitle: Create an account to access the clinic management system.
login.signUpDescription: Fill in your details to create your account.
login.clientSubtitle: Sign in with a link sent to your email.
login.clientDescription: We will email you a single-use sign-in link, valid for {minutes, number, integer} minutes.
login.magicLinkSent: If that email is registered, a sign-in link is on its way.
login.genericError: Could not sign you in. Check your details and try again.
login.emailTaken: That email address is already registered.
login.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.placeholder: Clinic appointments will appear here once the appointments module is built.

mealPlans.title: Meal plans
mealPlans.subtitle: Full-day plans built from the USDA food composition database.
mealPlans.empty: No meal plans yet. Create one to start building a day.
mealPlans.notFoundDescription: This plan may have been deleted, or the link is incorrect.
mealPlans.noClients: You need an active client before you can build a plan.
mealPlans.foodsNotSeeded: The food database is empty. Run `bun run db:seed:foods` to load it.
mealPlans.dataSource: Nutrition data: USDA FoodData Central, SR Legacy (April 2018) — public domain. Values are per 100 g as described.
mealPlans.emptySchedule: This plan has no meals. Add one to start.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.dayHint: Everything scheduled today. Select a meal to narrow this down.
analysis.mealHint: This meal only. Select it again to go back to the whole day.
analysis.empty: Add a food to see the analysis.
analysis.macroSplitNote: Percentages are of the energy the macronutrients account for (4/4/9 kcal per g), which can differ slightly from the total above.
analysis.unmeasured: {count, number, integer} of these foods have no published value for this nutrient, so the real total is higher.
analysis.unmeasuredNote: * Not measured for every food — the total is a minimum.
